subject: Investor readiness: forecast evidence and commit reconciliation (AtlasAI request)
messages:
From: Lauren Jacobs <ljacobs@atlasai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: AtlasAI Finance Team <finance@atlasai.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Investor data request — ARR/bookings evidence ahead of Fri investor meeting

Hi Soojin,

Quick ask — our board meeting is this Friday and the investors asked for a short packet: confirmed ARR, bookings supporting the Q1 call, and a reconciliation of any deals that moved stages in the last 60 days. Can you send a one-pager that shows: 1) ARR number you expect to record for Q1, 2) bookings recognized vs. committed pipeline, and 3) short notes on any deals >$150k that changed disposition in Jan/Feb?

If possible, we need this by EOD Thursday PST so we can incorporate into the investor deck. I attached the spreadsheet template we use for data ingestion.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Lauren Jacobs
Finance Director
AtlasAI

Attachments: Atlas-Investor-Q1-DataRequest.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Jacobs <ljacobs@atlasai.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Investor data request — ARR/bookings evidence ahead of Fri investor meeting

Folks — looped in above. Atlas needs a tight packet for their board by EOD Thu. This is a quick-hit reconciliation and a narrative summary (1p) — not a full finance audit. Owners:

- Ben: pull commit-log for all deals > $50k and flag any that were re-staged or re-signed since 2028-01-01. Provide a short justification line for each >$150k.
- Vanessa: consolidate bookings recognized vs. committed pipeline; produce a delta table and note timing/recognition assumptions.
- Karthik: sanity-check ARR bridge math and confirm whether we should pull deferred revenue adjustments into the Q1 number (call this out explicitly).

Target: draft ARR-evidence-pack.pdf + commit-log.csv attached back to Lauren by Thu 16:00 PST. If anything blocks you, call me — otherwise use the Atlas template and keep the narrative short (bullet list).

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Note: internal discussion — please do not forward raw spreadsheets externally until we have the PDF.
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 11:23:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Investor data request — ARR/bookings evidence ahead of Fri investor meeting

On it — quick update: I ran the commit export and reconciled stage changes. Two notes: 1) One $220k deal (Prospera Labs) moved from Negotiation to Closed-Won on 2028-02-10 but billing was delayed pending SOC-2 clause; 2) A $185k multi-year renewal was pushed from Best Case to Commit on 2028-02-02 after legal sign-off.

I've attached the raw commit-log.csv (redacted PII) — will annotate >$150k line items and return final ASAP.

Attachment: commit-log.csv (CSV)

Ben
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Jacobs <ljacobs@atlasai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Feb 2028 17:03:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Investor data request — ARR/bookings evidence ahead of Fri investor meeting

Hi Lauren — attaching the one-page packet and the commit log you requested. Summary below.

Summary (one-line): We expect to report $5.1M ARR for AtlasAI in Q1 (net of churn and deferred adjustments). Bookings recognized vs. committed show a $320k timing delta driven primarily by Prospera Labs billing delay; two deals >$150k moved into commit during the period (Prospera Labs $220k, VendorEdge renewal $185k).

What we attached:
- ARR-evidence-pack.pdf: one-page ARR figure, bridge table, and bullets on methodology and assumptions.
- commit-log.csv: stage history for all deals >$50k with short disposition notes for >$150k.

Next steps: If you want a separate spreadsheet with deferred revenue schedules, we can export that today — let me know. Otherwise this packet should be fine for the board appendix.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15m call if you want to walk through the numbers.

Best,

Soojin Lee
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134
